_comment: satk mta lint: facts about the Lua 5.1.5 VM of MTA:SA (libraries it opens, functions it disables, globals it sets) and satk's own rule data. Curated by satk from the MTA:SA and Lua 5.1 sources (names only, no documentation text).

disabled.dofile: scripts cannot read files directly: use fileOpen/fileRead or a <script> entry in meta.xml
disabled.loadfile: scripts cannot read files directly: use fileOpen/fileRead with loadstring
disabled.require: there are no Lua modules in MTA: list the file as a <script> in meta.xml or use exports
disabled.loadlib: native libraries cannot be loaded from scripts
disabled.newproxy: it does nothing and returns false
disabled.os.execute: it does nothing and returns false
disabled.os.exit: it does nothing and returns false
disabled.os.getenv: it does nothing and returns false
disabled.os.tmpname: it does nothing and returns false
disabled.os.setlocale: it does nothing and returns false

missing_libraries.io: the io library is not loaded in MTA: use fileOpen, fileRead, fileWrite, fileClose
missing_libraries.package: there are no Lua modules in MTA: list files as <script> in meta.xml or use exports
missing_libraries.bit: there is no bit library: use bitAnd, bitOr, bitXor, bitNot, bitLShift, bitRShift
missing_libraries.bit32: there is no bit32 library: use bitAnd, bitOr, bitXor, bitNot, bitLShift, bitRShift
missing_libraries.jit: MTA runs the plain Lua 5.1 interpreter (no LuaJIT)

render_heavy.dxCreateFont: creates a font every frame (memory grows until the client runs out of video memory)
render_heavy.dxCreateRenderTarget: creates a render target every frame
render_heavy.dxCreateScreenSource: creates a screen source every frame
render_heavy.guiCreateFont: creates a GUI font every frame
render_heavy.engineRequestModel: allocates a model id every frame
render_heavy.xmlLoadFile: reads an XML file every frame
render_heavy.fetchRemote: starts an HTTP request every frame
render_heavy.triggerServerEvent: sends a network message every frame
render_heavy.triggerLatentServerEvent: sends a network message every frame
render_heavy.setElementData: synchronises element data every frame (network traffic when synced)
render_heavy.outputChatBox: prints to the chat every frame
render_heavy.outputDebugString: prints to the debug console every frame
render_heavy.getElementsByType: walks every element of a type every frame: cache the list or use streamed-in elements
